name: Japan Masters
stakes: Lakshya Sen's historic title win at the Japan Masters significantly boosts his — and India's — momentum towards the season-ending BWF World Tour Finals.
summary:
India's campaign at the Japan Masters concluded on a high note, with **Lakshya Sen** delivering a stellar performance to clinch the men's singles title. This victory marks his second consecutive BWF Tour crown, following his triumph at the Hylo Open, and makes him the first Indian ever to win the Japan Masters. Sen's resurgence in form is timely, placing him in a strong position to qualify for the season-ending BWF World Tour Finals.

While Sen shone brightly, it was a quieter week for the rest of the Indian contingent. Top men's doubles pair **Satwik & Chirag**, seeded fourth, along with **PV Sindhu**, **Treesa & Gayatri**, **HS Prannoy**, and **Malvika Bansod**, all faced early exits from the Super 500 event. Despite the mixed results, Sen's breakthrough performance offers a significant boost to Indian badminton, highlighting his potential as a consistent title contender on the global stage.
